name: Dual Isosurfacing with Trilinear Optimization
aliases: Optimized Marching Cubes with Trilinear Analysis
definition: A method to determine the topology of an analytical isosurface within a voxel cell using trilinear interpolation, optimizing ray intersection by selecting specific diagonals to find exactly one point per disjoint isosurface component.
summary: Dual Isosurfacing with Trilinear Optimization resolves Marching Cubes topological ambiguity by using trilinear analysis to select diagonals, ensuring manifold correctness without cracks.
